body: I can reproduce this with a current master build (0dd9178269e447aca805bc4b4a9a840119c10275) No custom icon: With custom icon: I made a minimal project to reproduce it: [repro.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21438270/repro.zip) - If you don't see the godot icon on any of the existing resources after opening, add any new resource and it should have the wrong icon - Disable the custom icon in gdmappergraph.gd and reload the project -> icons normal - Enable custom icon again -> icons broken again (possibly only some, but should always include the resource added in 1st step, might have some order dependency)

As per `_get_resource_script_class()` documentation:
> Returns the script class name associated with the `Resource` under the given `path`. If the resource has no script or the script isn't a named class, it should return `""`.

It's up to the plugin to handle if it should ignore the given file or not.
